instruction: A candid studio photograph shows a medium full shot of two women dancing against a plain beige wall. On the left, the woman with an afro in a brown button-up dress (R1) is turned to the right, looking at her companion with her left hand raised near her head. On the right, the woman with short brown hair in a striped shirt and white trousers (R2) leans back playfully, touching her neck with her right hand while looking directly at the camera. Soft, warm studio lighting illuminates the pair, emphasizing their joyful, synchronized movement.
elements: R1 is turned toward R2 and looking at R2 while dancing
R2 leans back playfully while looking directly at the camera
R1 raises her left hand near her head
R2 touches her own neck with her right hand
the two women dance together in synchronized movement
